independence: judge receives only its own blind packet and output schema
no Project/GitHub/prior chat/internal lineage/internal scores/other judge output
mapping revealed only after 3/3 first schema-valid judgments are hash-sealed
continuity_axis_definition: Whether the scene's time, event windows, travel/movement, physical location, vehicle/container membership, and cross-scene presence are mutually possible and legible without chronology inversion or unexplained teleportation.
required_output: score A/B independently on all 8 whole axes
score A/B on all 14 literary surface axes for each of six prefrozen scenes
score A/B on TEMPORAL_SPATIAL_CONTINUITY for each of six prefrozen scenes
reconstruct premise, major threads, nine sequence movements, relationship trajectories, resolved due-now, deferred/open for each script
report critical violations with concrete scene evidence

frozen_gates.absolute_literary: Mapped Treatment whole mean >=7.0 for >=2/3 judges; mapped Treatment literary-surface mean >=7.0 for >=2/3; no critical violation of any frozen label confirmed on Treatment by >=2 judges.
frozen_gates.paired_literary: Mapped Treatment surface-craft preference wins >=2/3; whole preference wins+ties >=2/3.
frozen_gates.focus_literary: Mapped Treatment pooled median not lower than Control on CHARACTER_VOICE, DIALOGUE_SUBTEXT, PHYSICALIZATION_ACTION, KOREAN_SPOKEN_NATURALNESS; >=4 of 6 PA7 focus axes pooled median delta >=+0.5.
frozen_gates.recoverability: Mapped Treatment premise, major threads, nine sequence movements, relationship trajectories, due-now/deferred-open boundary recoverable at core-consensus by >=2/3 judges.
frozen_gates.continuity_absolute: Mapped Treatment TEMPORAL_SPATIAL_CONTINUITY mean >=7.0 for >=2/3 judges; no MAJOR_CAUSAL_OR_CONTINUITY_BREAK confirmed on Treatment by >=2 judges; deterministic Treatment spacetime preflight critical violations = 0.
frozen_gates.continuity_effect: If deterministic Control preblind diagnostic establishes >=1 target continuity violation (headroom), Treatment must reduce deterministic target violations and pooled TEMPORAL_SPATIAL_CONTINUITY median must be >= Control +0.50. If deterministic Control target violations = 0, classify continuity-effect claim as HOLD__NO_DETERMINISTIC_HEADROOM rather than PASS; literary/noninferiority results may still be reported but PA8 repair-effect qualification is not established.

no_posthoc_rule: Do not change sample, axes, definitions, thresholds, headroom rule, mapping, or critical labels after first screenplay output or first judge dispatch.
mapping: Balanced hidden mapping selected and sealed only after both mechanical-qualified surfaces exist; reveal after 3/3 first schema-valid judgments are sealed.
claim_boundary: PA8 is provider-analog/fresh-synthetic repair qualification. Even full PASS does not itself establish real-provider H1, Production promotion, Operational Level-3, or Formal R140.
